nodes.label: TV Series Detail Screenshot
nodes.rationale: The detail view for The Rookie combines an immersive backdrop and poster with genres, rating, release year, season and episode counts, age rating, synopsis, trailer and saved actions. Below it, season tabs and episode cards show watched state and episode summaries.

nodes.label: Trending Home Carousel Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Aureon's home screen presents separate Trending Movies and Trending Series carousels. Centered posters are emphasized while adjacent posters recede; rating and age badges, titles, year/type labels, dot indicators, and previous/next controls support browsing.

nodes.label: TMDB API Settings Screenshot
nodes.rationale: A step in the TMDB setup guide. The screenshot shows the API Settings tab, its account settings navigation, and the link used to request an API key. A handwritten arrow points at the request link.

nodes.label: Wyzie API Key Copy Screenshot
nodes.rationale: A German-language Wyzie dashboard page showing the completed email-verification step, a free API-key panel, plan details, and a warning not to expose the key in client-side code. The key field is visibly redacted in the project screenshot.

nodes.label: Download Modal Screenshot
nodes.rationale: The screenshot shows Aureon's download dialog with a detected stream URL, subtitle search toggle, downloader availability status, download location controls, and a prominent Start Download action. The stream URL is intentionally not copied into this note.

nodes.label: Subtitle API Settings Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Aureon's subtitle settings show Wyzie Subs as the default provider, an auto-download toggle, a preferred language selector, a masked Wyzie API key, an optional SubDL API key field, and a Save button. The credential remains masked.

nodes.label: Aureon Brand Logo
nodes.rationale: A compact black, transparent app mark combines a film strip with a monocle and curled moustache motif, reinforcing the cinema and media identity.

nodes.label: Aureon App Icon (64×64)
nodes.rationale: A monochrome, compact Aureon mark combining a film clapper and a small cinema-themed emblem. This is the 64×64 packaged application icon variant.
